items.title: Canada's Six Biggest Banks Team Up on a Shared Digital-Dollar Network
items.summary: RBC, TD, BMO, Scotiabank, CIBC and National Bank are jointly exploring a Canadian-dollar tokenized deposit system, starting with transfers between the banks themselves.

items.title: ‘BTC still has room to catch up’: Bitcoin’s $80,000 breakout draws institutional demand as analysts weigh durability
items.summary: K33, Nexo and 21shares weigh in on bitcoin's breakout as ETF inflows hit their highest since Nov.

items.title: Bitwise launches first Lighter ETP amid Hyperliquid rivalry
items.summary: The product gives European investors brokerage access to the LIT token as Bitwise expands its lineup of products tied to decentralized derivatives platforms.

items.title: Inside the FBI’s little-known annual crypto crime gathering
items.summary: The Virtual Asset Technical Exchange brings together investigators, law enforcement officials, and crypto-security specialists to exchange intelligence on a wide range of crimes involving digital assets.
